event_summary: An orange hanging ball with metal hardware moves downward until its bottom meets the wooden tabletop, then stays nearly still.
raw_event_description: At the start, an orange spherical object with shiny metal hardware is hanging in front of a gray wall and beside a vertical mirror. The object, its orange cord, its metal hardware, its wall shadow, and its mirror reflection all shift downward over time. The orange sphere approaches the tabletop, its lower edge reaches the tabletop surface, and afterward the hanging object remains nearly stationary with the sphere resting at the surface line.

reasons: The orange sphere, metal hardware, tabletop, wall, and mirror are visible.
The upper part of the cord extends out of the top of the frame.
The object is already hanging above the tabletop at the first frame.
